## Goal

When `docket done <bug>` is run from trunk, it should auto-detect and switch to that bug's workspace to perform the full workspace workflow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Detect if bug has a workspace at `../ws-<bug-id>`
- [ ] If workspace exists, cd to it before running workspace workflow
- [ ] Run the full workspace workflow (snapshot, describe, link, sync)
- [ ] Return to original directory after completion
- [ ] If no workspace exists, behave as current (just mark done)

## Context

Current pain point:
1. `docket work <bug>` - starts claude in workspace
2. Quit claude - back in trunk (exec behavior)
3. Must manually `cd ../ws-<bug>`
4. Run `docket done <bug>`
5. Must manually `cd` back

Improved flow:
1. `docket work <bug>` - starts claude in workspace
2. Quit claude - back in trunk
3. `docket done <bug>` - auto-finds workspace, does everything
4. Done!
